Bring a checked institution sheet back into the data

Source: R/institutions_clean.R
institutions_merge.Rd

Applies the sheet that [institutions_clean()] wrote with `level = "all"`, after it was checked outside R, and returns the data frame. The confirmed steps of [institutions_clean()] run again (OpenAlex's answers come from the cache), then the sheet, read one of two ways:

* `by = "merge"` (default), for a person or a model that adds a column `merge` and answers `yes` or `no` in it: * a `needs_revision` row with `yes` becomes its `name`, and joins it when the name is an identified institution; * a `confirmed` row with `no` keeps its own name, also when it came to an identified institution by its address or name; * anything else keeps what the row's `status` says. * `by = "edit"`, for a tool that rewrites the names themselves, such as OpenRefine clustering the `institution` column: every institution whose `institution` no longer equals its untouched `institution_backup` becomes the new text. An edited `confirmed` row moves only that spelling. Identified institutions keep their names.

Pass the same arguments as to [institutions_clean()].

Usage

institutions_merge(
  data,
  decisions,
  by = c("merge", "edit"),
  affiliations = "C1",
  doi = "DI",
  replace = NULL,
  openalex = TRUE,
  cache = .in_default_cache(),
  mailto = NULL,
  output = c("minimal", "all")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per paper.

decisions

The checked sheet: a data frame or the path of the `.xlsx` or `.csv` file.

by

`"merge"` (default) reads the `merge` column; `"edit"` reads the edits of `institution` against `institution_backup`.

affiliations, doi, replace, openalex, cache, mailto, output

As in [institutions_clean()].

Value

`data`, same class and rows, with `AU_UN` written as by [institutions_clean()]; with `output = "all"`, plus its columns. A message counts the rows applied from the sheet.

Errors

Raises `saqrmisc_bad_input` for a missing sheet; with `by = "merge"`, one without `name`, `status`, `merge` and `institution_backup` (or `institution`), or a `merge` other than empty, `yes` or `no`; with `by = "edit"`, one without `institution` and `institution_backup`; and the errors of [institutions_clean()].

See also

[institutions_clean()]

Examples

papers <- data.frame(
  DI = NA_character_,
  C1 = c("UNIVERSITY OF TURKU, FINLAND", "UNIVERSITY OF TURKU, FINLAND", "TURKU UNIVERSITY, FINLAND",
         "UNIVERSITY OF OULU, FINLAND")
)
sheet <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
unchanged <- institutions_clean(papers, level = "all", decisions = sheet, min_papers = 1,
                                openalex = FALSE)
#> file1ff63fc1886b.csv: 3 groups and single institutions, 0 confirmed merges and 0 to check, institutions in 1 or more papers. Nothing is merged yet: add a column `merge` (yes or no), then institutions_merge(data, decisions = "file1ff63fc1886b.csv"). A prompt for a model is in file1ff63fc1886b_prompt.txt.
checked <- utils::read.csv(sheet)
checked$merge <- ifelse(checked$institution == "TURKU UNIVERSITY", "yes", "no")
utils::write.csv(checked, sheet, row.names = FALSE)
institutions_merge(papers, decisions = sheet, openalex = FALSE)
#> institutions_merge: from file1ff63fc1886b.csv, 0 merge(s) applied, 0 confirmed merge(s) undone
#> institutions: 3 institutions in 4 of 4 papers; links by OpenAlex ID 0, by an address OpenAlex linked 0, by OpenAlex name 0, from address text 4, by your table or sheet 0
#>     DI                           C1               AU_UN
#> 1 <NA> UNIVERSITY OF TURKU, FINLAND UNIVERSITY OF TURKU
#> 2 <NA> UNIVERSITY OF TURKU, FINLAND UNIVERSITY OF TURKU
#> 3 <NA>    TURKU UNIVERSITY, FINLAND    TURKU UNIVERSITY
#> 4 <NA>  UNIVERSITY OF OULU, FINLAND  UNIVERSITY OF OULU
